values.note: 13 of the 20 sites reservable on recreation.gov (or 1-877-444-6777) at least 4 days and up to 6 months ahead; 7 first-come. Two-night weekend and three-night holiday-weekend minimums (recreation.gov rules). 14 nights in any 30. A reserved site not occupied by check-out time the day after arrival goes to first-come. 2026 reservation season May 22 - Sept 7 (2027: May 28 - Sept 6). Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out before 11 a.m.

note: Rio Grande NF double-loop campground in a willow meadow on the Rio Grande just below Rio Grande Reservoir (2.3 mi to its lower end), ~9,250 ft: from Creede 20.1 mi southwest on CO 149, then 9.5 mi west on gravel FR 520 (Rio Grande Reservoir Rd). Many sites well screened by trees. Popular; usually full mid-June through August. Weminuche Creek and Grizzly Creek trails into the Weminuche Wilderness nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: confirmed $29 base, 20 sites, vault toilets, well water, reservable with first-come sites. Added max spur 55 ft (FS), pull-throughs, season note (Memorial Day-Labor Day weekends), booking window 6 months/4-day cutoff/2-3 night weekend minimums/14-in-30/reservation season May 22-Sept 7, senior-pass discount, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: field facts and the unsourced 'most take up to ~30 ft' dropped. Electric 0 (catalog) left, with the FS hookup fee flagged.
flags: Phone missing: Divide Ranger District (719) 657-3321 (FS campground page contact; Del Norte). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's lines instead: facility phone 719-658-0829 and 'For facility specific information, please call (805) 434-1996' (email customerservice@pmcparks.com).
Operator: concessionaire (PMC, pmcparks.com) on Rio Grande NF land per recreation.gov's contact details; ownership left federal.

Hookup conflict: the FS fee table lists 'Single Site with Hookup: $34 per night', but recreation.gov's catalog types all 18 listed sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC with no electric attribute (and recreation.gov's rates show only the $29 nonelectric rate). The old note's 'a few sites have electric hookup' has no other support; electric 0 (catalog-derived) left as is. The FS lists 20 sites, the catalog 18.

Length: FS 'Maximum spur length is 55 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' recreation.gov's catalog lists 25-125 ft (005 at 25 ft is the only site under 45; 125 ft at 011/013 is a placeholder). Recorded the FS 55. The old note's 'most take up to ~30 ft' is not on any agency page and was dropped.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored riverfront): on Esri imagery the Rio Grande at the campground is ~20-25 m of open water, under the ~30 m line, so by size it reads creekside rather than riverfront. Sites 001 and 005 (west loop) sit at the loop road ~10-15 m from the water behind a narrow willow fringe, 002 ~25 m; in the east loop 014 is ~15 m and 009-013 ~25-40 m from the bank, separated by willows but no developed strip. recreation.gov's overview: 'a popular campground on the banks of the Rio Grande River'. No per-site water tag in the catalog.

Road: FR 520 'Rio Grande Reservoir' is Open in the Divide RD road table (last updated June 11, 2026): 'Summer: Passenger car accessible to Lost Trail Trailhead. Beyond Lost Trail, high clearance and 4x4 required' (Lost Trail is beyond the campground and the reservoir). The forest-wide flood alert of October 23, 2026 warns 'Various roads throughout the Forest are impassible'; FR 520 is not among the damaged roads listed on the conditions page. No campground closure; past its season.

Pin 37.73000,-107.23180 (the FS/rec.gov facility point, on the main road north of the west loop) is ~280 m W of the catalog site centroid (37.72998,-107.22864) and ~55 m from site 004. Within tolerance.
